extracted.intended_audience: readers of 18th-century political pamphlets and the general literate public (historians, students of political discourse)
extracted.subtask_description: A first‑person public reply (letter) defending political conduct and attacking an anonymous critic (Junius), aimed at persuading the reading public and peers. The text is an 18th‑century polemical pamphlet/letter addressing accusations, principles of public conduct, and political argument.
